answer: Each identity locks 900 POA for 12 epochs with no yield and no resale. First the coins lock; a pearl grows around that key—a receipt that burns if assigned. Next, once each epoch the check opens as a lotus does at dawn; the same key has 45 seconds to sign a fresh nonce or payouts freeze. A gale of 20-second probes hits every bonded key at once; a miss or reused receipt slashes the 900. An honest agent idles 900 POA for 72 hours; 1,000 fakes need 900,000, above ~8,000 they could farm. Weakness: a desk holding many keys; mitigation: the gale is simultaneous, and same-parent receipts are seized.
